messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: High error rate detected on /v1/embeddings (prod-eu). 5xx rate from backend workers spiked to 18% over the last 2m. Alerting oncall.
incidents-bot: alert_id=INC-2026-0315-emb-01, severity=P1, affected_routes=[/v1/embeddings], impact=customer-visible errors for some keys, autodetecting surge pattern.
alice.park: oncall here, looking. can someone pull top client keys hitting embeddings?
ben_m: pulling logs now — looks like one client key (org-BX) is responsible for ~65% of requests in the last 3m, mostly batched embeddings for vector indexing.
carol_ops: paging @oncall-night for immediate mitigation, this is causing queue growth on embedding workers and cascading latency on other routes.
oncall-night: acked, taking it. first step: throttle offending key and apply route-level emergency quota.
oncall-night: running emergency commands — will set per-key quota to avoid noisy neighbor.
deploy-bot: Executing action: redwoodctl quota update --key org-BX --route embeddings --limit-per-minute 600 --note "emergency throttle due to surge"
carol_ops: also propose lowering global embeddings concurrency for prod-eu while we stabilize, to protect other endpoints.
ben_m: agree. we should also consider temporarily disabling rerank on public routes — it's CPU-heavy and not essential for core chat flows.
alice.park: customer impact: CS reports sporadic failures for orgs using embeddings for search indexing. we need to notify CS and reduce blast radius.
cs-lead: got it. I'll draft a customer-safe message: "We're currently mitigating an elevated error rate affecting embeddings in EU. We've applied temporary rate limits to reduce disruption. If you're seeing failures, share request IDs and we'll prioritize."
oncall-night: applying route-level changes now. runbook snippet: ```
# emergency route throttle
POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/quotas
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "scope": "route",
  "limit_per_minute": 2000,
  "burst": 3000,
  "regions": ["eu"],
  "note": "emergency protective limit"
}
```
ben_m: also bump chat route headroom so chat customers aren't affected: ```
redwoodctl quota update --route chat --limit-per-minute 12000 --burst 20000 --region eu
```
alice.park: concrete per-endpoint plan: 1) throttle key org-BX to 600/min 2) set route /v1/embeddings to 2000/min in EU 3) disable rerank for public tier in EU 4) raise chat route to 12k/min headroom 5) monitor error rate and worker queues for 15m before further changes.
carol_ops: executing disable for rerank (public). command: ```
redwoodctl feature toggle --feature rerank --scope public --region eu --state off --reason "protecting inference workers"
```
oncall-night: done — rerank toggled off for public in eu. seeing immediate drop in CPU on embedding cluster.
ben_m: embedding 5xx down from 18% -> 6% in 4 minutes. queue length halved. great. keep monitoring.
cs-lead: posted customer message on status.redwood.com and pinged top 5 customers we know use embeddings in EU. awaiting replies.
alice.park: handoff note for day team (in ~3h): leave org-BX throttle in place until we have a postmortem and follow-up with that customer on a request pattern analysis. consider long-term per-route dynamic quotas.
oncall-night: adding follow-up tasks to incident: - investigate why org-BX had such bursty embedding jobs - evaluate rate-limit UI/auto suggestions - consider per-client weighted quotas for batch embeddings
ben_m: quick config we applied (copy): ```
{ "changes": [
  {"type":"key_quota","key":"org-BX","route":"embeddings","limit_per_minute":"600"},
  {"type":"route_quota","route":"/v1/embeddings","region":"eu","limit_per_minute":"2000","burst":"3000"},
  {"type":"route_quota","route":"/v1/chat","region":"eu","limit_per_minute":"12000"},
  {"type":"feature_toggle","feature":"rerank","scope":"public","region":"eu","state":"off"}
 ] }
```
carol_ops: Can we add a temporary metric alert for embeddings queue length > 80% for 2m so we don't wait until 5xx spikes?
oncall-night: done — new alert rule created in metrics: embeddings_queue_utilization_eu > 0.8 for 2m -> page.
alice.park: monitoring dashboard: latency returning to normal for chat and embeddings tail latency improving. embedding error rate ~3% now.
cs-lead: received two customer PMs — both saw retries succeed after limits applied; one asked for ETA to re-enable rerank. I told them we'll review once error rate stable for 30m.
oncall-night: preparing handoff to day oncall. summary: emergency quotas applied, rerank public disabled in eu, key org-BX throttled. current status: degraded -> stabilizing. no data exfil concerns.
oncall-night: handoff @alice.park — timestamp 1772000891. please take over monitoring and customer comms.
alice.park: taking handoff. will monitor until 1772002600, will start a postmortem doc and include suggested remediation: per-endpoint soft quotas, automated noisy-key detection, and safer rerank CPU caps.
ben_m: extra note — evaluate offering a per-route token bucket for batch embeddings to reduce sudden spikes (e.g., per-API-key smoothers).
carol_ops: thanks team. I'll create incident channel and attach logs + sample request ids for org-BX. please add any follow-up owners. :thumbsup:
